#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline atomic HTTP/3 -> HTTP/1.1 bridge fixture translator.

Reads one JSON scenario from stdin and writes the audit ledger as one JSON
object on stdout.  Diagnostics (if any) go to stderr only.

Octet convention: every string in a header field pair and in the output ledger
denotes octets, where Unicode code points U+0000..U+00FF map to the single byte
with that value; i.e. latin-1 is the octet codec.  JSON transport is UTF-8.

No sockets, no child processes, no filesystem writes: pure translation.
"""

import json
import os
import sys
from ipaddress import IPv6Address

DEBUG = bool(os.environ.get('BRIDGE_DEBUG'))

MAX_CONTENT = 65536          # bytes of concatenated DATA per stream
MAX_SECTION_SIZE = 8192      # uncompressed HEADERS section size per section

# --- octet classes -------------------------------------------------------

_TCHAR = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"
NAME_OCTETS = frozenset(_TCHAR.encode('ascii'))

_VISIBLE = frozenset(range(0x21, 0x7F)) | frozenset(range(0x80, 0x100))
_INNER = _VISIBLE | {0x20, 0x09}
